'''Vos Gesal Street''' was a street in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], along which the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] was located. In the north of Uscru, 100 kilometers from the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]], it crossed [[Daring Way]]. Named for the legendary singing family who made their name in the area's earliest clubs and bars, the street was popular with singers, musicians, and entertainers.

The [[Vos Gesal Hotel/Legends|Vos Gesal Hotel]] and the [[Snapping Septoid/Legends|Snapping Septoid]] were also located on Vos Gesal Street. [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell's]] [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] crash-landed on this street.
